entities.name: PMID:25517030
observations: In an in-vitro renal stem/progenitor-cell tubule-generation model, tannic-acid-containing fixation for TEM revealed extracellular matrix not visible with conventional glutaraldehyde fixation; authors described abnormal features in the newly developed interstitium.

entities.name: PMID:22337593
observations: In experimental regenerating tubules, tannic-acid/ruthenium-red labeling showed a dense fiber network along the basal lamina; matured tubules showed a different staining pattern, demonstrating regional extracellular-matrix differences.

entities.name: PMID:10810981
observations: Modified tannic-acid–ferric-chloride staining visualized renal basement membrane, brush border, basolateral invaginations, and cell processes; it was a membrane-visualization method, not a marker of abnormal cell development.
